create.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Photosynthesis, World War II, Basic fractions
create.topicHint: AI will create educational flashcards from the topic alone — no notes required.
create.urlHint: We fetch readable text or captions (private networks blocked).
create.uploadNeedsSecret: File uploads need SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY in .env.local. Text generation still works.
create.materialPlaceholder: Paste notes, an article, or lesson content…
create.fileHint: Maximum 10 MB; text files maximum 2 MB.
create.energyShort: Not enough energy. Need {need}, have {have}. Energy refills each week.
create.quizModeNote: Quiz decks generate multiple-choice questions for battle mode.
create.noProviders: Add OPENROUTER_API_KEY before creating an AI deck. File uploads also need SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY. You can still use Create sample deck to try study and sharing.
create.uploadSecretError: Add SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY to .env.local to upload files
create.unrelated: This source doesn’t look like study material. Paste notes, a lesson, or an article — not random chat or memes.
create.insufficient: Not enough usable study content for that many cards. Add more notes or try fewer cards.

tips: Flip a card before you rate it — recall first, then check.
Use Hard / OK / Easy so you know what to revisit later.
Shuffle when you start memorizing card order instead of answers.
Fewer cards and shorter notes usually finish faster.
Paste text or use TXT when a scanned PDF is hard to read.
Share links are read-only; signed-in users can save progress.
You can edit any card after generation before you study.

legal.governingLanguage: The English text of these policies is the official version. Other UI languages are for the interface only.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {operator} (“we”, “us”) collects and uses information when you use {product}.
privacy.s1b: We operate {product}. For privacy questions, email {email}.
privacy.s2a: Account data: when you sign in through Clerk, we receive identifiers such as your user ID, email address, and basic profile information needed to keep you signed in.
privacy.s2b: Study data: decks, flashcards, study sessions, ratings, and share settings you create are stored in our database (Supabase Postgres).
privacy.s2c: Uploads: if you upload a file, it is stored temporarily in private Supabase Storage so we can generate cards. After a successful generation we clear retained source text and delete the upload when possible.
privacy.s2d: Technical data: standard server logs and essential cookies for authentication and preferences (including language).
privacy.s3b: We use your information to provide accounts, generate flashcards, save study progress, enable sharing links you turn on, and keep the service secure.
privacy.s4b: To generate cards, study material is sent to OpenRouter, which routes it to the model you select. Cloud providers process inputs under their own terms.
privacy.s5b: If you enable a share link, anyone with that link can view and study the deck. Signed-in users may save study progress on shared decks.
privacy.s6b: Account and deck data remain until you delete the deck or ask us to delete your data. Source uploads and source text are removed after successful generation for privacy.
privacy.s7b: We use Clerk (authentication), Supabase (database and storage), and optionally cloud AI providers you configure. We do not sell your personal data and do not use advertising cookies.
privacy.s8b: You can sign out, delete decks you own, disable share links, and contact us at {email} to request access or deletion of your account data. Full self-serve account deletion may be added later.
privacy.s9b: This policy is governed by the laws of {jurisdiction}, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.

terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of {product}, operated by {operator}. By using the service you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy.
terms.s1b: {product} helps you turn notes, documents, and images into flashcards and study them. Features may change as we improve the product.
terms.s2b: You must keep your sign-in credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. Do not share accounts in a way that violates these Terms.
terms.s3b: Do not upload content you do not have rights to use, illegal material, malware, or content intended to abuse the AI or infrastructure. Do not attempt to bypass security or rate limits.
terms.s4b: Flashcards are generated by AI and may be incomplete, outdated, or wrong. {product} is a study aid, not a substitute for course materials, teachers, or professional advice. Always verify important facts before exams or professional use.
terms.s5b: You retain rights to content you upload. You grant us a limited license to process that content solely to provide the service (including sending it to the AI provider you select). After successful generation we aim to delete retained source uploads and source text.
terms.s6b: If you create a share link, you are responsible for who you share it with. Shared decks may be viewed by anyone with the link.
terms.s7b: We may modify, suspend, or discontinue features. We may update these Terms; the “Last updated” date will change when we do.
terms.s8b: The service is provided “as is” without warranties to the fullest extent permitted by law. To the maximum extent permitted, {operator} is not liable for indirect or consequential damages, or for exam outcomes or decisions made based on AI-generated cards.
terms.s9b: Questions about these Terms: {email}. Governing law: {jurisdiction}.

cookies.intro: {product} uses essential cookies and similar technologies to run the app.
cookies.s1b: Authentication and session cookies from Clerk keep you signed in. We may also store a language preference cookie ({localeCookie}) so the interface stays in your chosen language.
cookies.s2b: We do not use third-party advertising cookies or sell browsing data for ads.
cookies.s3b: You can clear cookies in your browser. Signing out ends your Clerk session. Blocking all cookies may prevent sign-in from working.
cookies.s4b: See also our Privacy Policy for how authentication cookies work. Contact: {email}.

community.title: Community
community.subtitle: An illustrated topic library — copy a pack to study. Create-your-own decks may pick up photos when a picture really helps.
community.empty: No public decks match these filters.

quiz.title: Quiz battle
quiz.subtitle: Pick the right answer. Build your streak.

account.title: Settings
account.signedIn: Signed in as {email}. Password and email sign-in are managed below.
account.deleteBody: Account deletion is by email only. Write to {email} and we will delete your account data.

welcome.title: Welcome to your library
welcome.body: New accounts start here. This page is where every deck you create will live.

create.title: Create a deck
create.body: Paste notes, type a topic, or upload a PDF. Or make a sample deck first if you just want to try study and play.

study.title: Study
study.body: Flip the card, then rate Hard / OK / Easy. Hard cards come back sooner.

play.title: Play
play.body: Matching: tap a question on the left, then its answer on the right. A match disappears. Type the answer: type the term, then Check. Close matches need a yes from AI.

quiz.title: Quiz and share
quiz.body: Quiz battle tests recall. When you are ready, share a read-only link with class.

play.title: Play · {deck}
play.subtitle: Fifteen themed games on the same cards. A round uses weekly allowance; score 50%+ to get it back, and a perfect run returns double.
play.subtitlePublic: Two study games on the same cards: match questions to answers, or type the answer. A round uses weekly allowance; score 50%+ to get it back, and a perfect run returns double.
play.quitWarning: Quit or leave this page and the {stake} stays spent.
play.anteHelp: A round uses {stake} weekly allowance. Leave before you finish and it stays spent. Score 50%+ to get it back; 80%+ returns 30; a perfect run returns 40.
play.sayAloud: Say the answer out loud, then reveal.

match-up.name: Match up
match-up.blurb: Tap a term, then its definition.

matching-pairs.name: Twin lanterns
matching-pairs.blurb: Pair Mid-Autumn lanterns on the harbourfront.
matching-pairs.howTo: Flip two lanterns. A match stays lit. A miss goes dark and a decoy slides in.

find-the-match.name: Find the match
find-the-match.blurb: Tap the matching answer until the bank is empty.

type-the-answer.name: Ink well
type-the-answer.blurb: Write the term before the 揮春 ink dries.
type-the-answer.howTo: Type the term and chop, then stamp the 揮春 before the seal dries. Empty ink does not count.

spell-the-word.name: Spell the word
spell-the-word.blurb: Build a short answer from letter tiles.

unjumble.name: Unjumble
unjumble.blurb: Unscramble the letters of a short answer.

hangman.name: Hangman
hangman.blurb: Guess letters of a short answer. Six misses.

complete-the-sentence.name: Complete the sentence
complete-the-sentence.blurb: Pick the missing word from a chip bank.

true-or-false.name: True or false
true-or-false.blurb: Is this pairing real, or swapped from another card?

open-the-box.name: Open the box
open-the-box.blurb: Pick a box, then answer the card inside.

group-sort.name: Homework trays
group-sort.blurb: Flick papers into labelled classroom trays.
group-sort.howTo: Flick the paper into a tray, or tap a tray. Misses go to a redo stack.

odd-one-out.name: Odd one out
odd-one-out.blurb: Three belong together. Tap the one that does not.

rank-order.name: Rank order
rank-order.blurb: Put cards in the deck’s study order.

image-quiz.name: Image quiz
image-quiz.blurb: Look at the picture. Choose the matching name.

crossword.name: Crossword
crossword.blurb: Fill short answers from the clues.

wordsearch.name: Wordsearch
wordsearch.blurb: Find short answers hidden in the grid.

win-or-lose.name: Detention hall
win-or-lose.blurb: Three late slips. Streak of facts, not a gameshow.
win-or-lose.howTo: Slips drift across the desk. Stamp one in the window. Keys A–C. A miss shows WhyBox.

speaking-cards.name: Speaking cards
speaking-cards.blurb: Say the answer aloud, then check yourself.

whack-a-mole.name: Pop-quiz desks
whack-a-mole.blurb: Only a standing student is hittable. Chips hide when seated.
whack-a-mole.howTo: A standing desk peeks its chip briefly. Hit the match. Seated desks do not score.

balloon-pop.name: Balloon pop
balloon-pop.blurb: Pop the balloon that matches the prompt.

maze-chase.name: Prefect’s corridor
maze-chase.blurb: Late for assembly. Four coloured doors. Avoid the prefect.
maze-chase.howTo: Chips flash on the colour doors, then hide. Walk to the matching door. Avoid the prefect.

airplane.name: Airplane
airplane.blurb: Fly into the cloud with the right answer.

labelled-diagram.name: Labelled diagram
labelled-diagram.blurb: Match each picture on the diagram to its label.

label-match.name: Label match
label-match.blurb: Drag-tap labels onto the matching pictures.

gate-dash.name: Gate dash
gate-dash.blurb: Paper-plane a covered footbridge. Tap a sign to fly the plane into that gate.
gate-dash.howTo: Signs flash chips, then go blank. Tap a lane or press 1 / 2 / 3 to fly.

last-car.name: Last car
last-car.blurb: Last train of the night. Board the matching door, duck the rest.
last-car.howTo: Peek the door chips, then Board the matching door or Duck a wrong one.

ding-ding.name: Ding ding
ding-ding.blurb: Tap when the matching tram-bell chip crosses the strike line.
ding-ding.howTo: Two or three trams ride the line. Bell only if the tram on the neon line matches the prompt.

estate-court.name: Estate court
estate-court.blurb: Sitting-out area. Right cards orbit as 新聞紙 and auto-clear matches.
estate-court.howTo: Only the front 新聞紙 shows its chip. Tap that paper. Wrong papers bump you.

mosaic-wall.name: Mosaic wall
mosaic-wall.blurb: Cha chaan teng 花磚. Break the matching tile with a milk-tea paddle.
mosaic-wall.howTo: Break the 花磚 under the milk-tea paddle. A wrong tile cracks the glass.

minibus-stop.name: Minibus stop
minibus-stop.blurb: Tap Board when the matching-chip van lines up with the pole.
minibus-stop.howTo: A van only shows its chip at the pole. Board in that window.

station-lost.name: Station lost property
station-lost.blurb: Claim ticket in hand. Tap the matching bag in the jumble.
station-lost.howTo: Hold a bag to peek the chip, then claim the match in the jumble.

ticket-chops.name: Ticket chops
ticket-chops.blurb: Chop if the stub matches. Pass a decoy.
ticket-chops.howTo: The stub peeks then blanks. Chop a match, Pass a decoy. No loot boxes.

street-flyers.name: Street flyers
street-flyers.blurb: Slash only the matching 街招. Penalty notices cost a life.
street-flyers.howTo: Flyers drift. Slash the matching 街招 in the lane. A red penalty notice costs a life.

blocked.needBins: Need two labelled groups with two cards each.
